messages:
Mina (Support): Customer (acct: acme-media-new) just pinged asking for a 10x rate limit uplift for the hosted API. They say they're launching a campaign tomorrow and need 100k req/min. :grimacing:
Jasper (Sales): who is the point of contact? any signed contract?
Mina (Support): contact is laura@acme-media.com, new account created 3 days ago, billing not yet verified. no contract in SFDC. they attached a load plan doc that looks generic. link: https://files.internal/acme-uplift-plan
Sasha (Product): red flags: new account + no billing + very high burst. we should run basic abuse screening before any permanent uplift. short-term: can we offer a temporary scoped bump with token caps?
Eli (FraudOps): agree. initial checks I ran: IPs spread across 4 subnets, traffic pattern shows steady long-running connections hitting embeddings endpoint, token length distribution is extremely low (avg 5 tokens) — smells like scraping or bot amplification. can we get request/response samples?
Mina (Support): I asked for sample logs and business justification. customer says it's for "personalization scoring" across CDN, sent a CSV sample (50k rows). shared S3 link.
Ravi (Infra): ops-bot shows current per-customer limit is 5k rps, we can create a temporary policy to ~20k rps on hosted tier but it needs a manual guardrail: burst window + hard cap + monitoring alert. command to create policy: `redwoodctl limits set --customer acme-media-new --rps 20000 --burst 25000 --expires 24h`
Jasper (Sales): ok let's not promise 100k. can we offer 24h scoped uplift to 20k while FraudOps completes review? need one-liner email for customer that legal/ops will verify billing and traffic.
Eli (FraudOps): next steps from our side: (1) validate billing/KYC, (2) inspect sample responses for PII/leak patterns, (3) review account creation fingerprinting (device + ip history). If any step fails keep uplift limited or revoke. If they pass, recommend staged rollout to 50k over 72h with monitoring.
Sasha (Product): product asks to capture this as a formal intake: reason, target rps, endpoints, sample payloads, customer risk level, desired SLA. I'll make a quick intake template so we can avoid back-and-forth next time. Proposed fields: `customer_id`, `contact_email`, `requested_limit`, `duration`, `endpoints`, `business_use_case`, `billing_verified`, `attached_samples`, `sales_owner`, `fraud_flag`.
Mina (Support): drafting the email now. Proposed text: "We can approve a temporary 24h uplift to 20k rps while we validate billing and traffic. Please send a recent invoice/purchase order and representative example requests/responses. Uplift will be revoked if screening detects abuse." Want sign-off from FraudOps and Infra before sending.
Eli (FraudOps): sign-off conditional on sample review + billing. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Infra): I can run the uplift within 30m once you give the OK. I'll attach an automated alert to #eng-oncall for >70% of burst.
Jasper (Sales): please copy this exact sentence in my reply: "Temporary 24-hour increase to 20k rps approved pending receipt of billing verification and sample logs; uplift may be revoked if automated screening raises concerns."
Mina (Support): sent to customer at 2026-03-20 16:42 UTC. awaiting docs. created support ticket S-2026-4872.
Sasha (Product): I'll create a product backlog ticket to ship the intake template + automated gating for temporary uplifts. Proposed prioritization: P1 for abuse-prone endpoints (embeddings) with low friction for sales. assigning to me.
Eli (FraudOps): please tag me on the ticket. we should also document common indicators (short token distro, new billing, many subnets, CSV-based batch) so support can triage faster.
Ravi (Infra): note for runbook: use `redwoodctl` with `--expires` + `--audit-note` and create CloudWatch/Datadog alert: `agent.uplift_usage_pct > 70`
Mina (Support): next actions captured: 1) FraudOps review samples (Eli) 2) Infra to stand by for uplift (Ravi) 3) Sales to collect billing/PO (Jasper) 4) Product to open intake/backlog task (Sasha). I'll update S-2026-4872 with status.
Jasper (Sales): thanks everyone. keep me posted. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: uptime check scheduled for uplift window; notification will post to #eng-oncall if threshold crossed.
